tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search Crimp's catalog by name, manufacturer, model or ID. Returns stable catalog IDs and published component data; use get_component for terminals and full fields. Read-only; no AI model call.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Read one exact catalog component, including terminal IDs, electrical specs and known configuration. Catalog data does not verify an installed part or its protection evidence.

tools.name: calculate_circuit
tools.description: Run the existing wire or DC-DC calculator deterministically. Every input field is required: use null for unknown numbers/options and an empty string for missing evidence. Unknown evidence stays unknown. kind=wire requires the wire input shape; kind=dc-dc requires the charger input shape. No fuse sel

tools.name: analyze_system
tools.description: Analyze an explicit current-schema System with Crimp's canonical sizing, diagnostics and energy engine. Read-only. Maximum 40 component nodes, 20 zones and 100 cables. Unknown fields, invalid references and other schema versions are rejected. Results preserve provisional currents, unknown fault prot

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Build and analyze a new reviewable Crimp draft from exact catalog IDs and structured connections, without an AI model call.
